messages:
Elaine (PM): heads up — InterNexus reported auth failures on Dedicated yesterday, they want a fix asap. Should we treat as hotfix or schedule for next sprint?
Priya (Support): customer seeing 401s on token refresh path, ~20% of requests during heavy load. They hit dedicated capacity but said data is PII, high priority.
Sam (Eng): we traced to token caching edge case when KV cache misses and fallback route hits legacy auth. Simple patch (~3–4h) but needs validation across quantized models.
Olga (SRE): risk: pushing a runtime change to hosted runtime could affect other tenants if rollout not isolated. Need canary + quick rollback.
Marco (Release): timeline: if hotfix, we can ship a dedicated hotpatch window tomorrow 10–12 UTC, with canary to 5% traffic. Otherwise it lands in 2-week release.
Elaine (PM): customer is on a paid Dedicated plan and asked for fast turnaround. Priya, any SLA language?
Priya (Support): InterNexus flagged as enterprise with 99.9 SLA, CS told them well prioritize. They're okay with short maintenance window and can tolerate a 5‑10 min degraded behavior if warned.
Sam (Eng): technical: patch alters token refresh path and adds a KV-prefetch step. Should be safe but we need to run model smoke tests and embedding pipeline smoke. I estimate deploy -> monitor 2.5h, plus QA.
Marco (Release): propose hotfix path: build branch, run smoke test suite, deploy canary 5% for 30m, if error rate <0.5% promote. Rollback script ready.
Marco (Release): rollback command: `./deploy rollback --env=prod --to=release/2026-03-19`
Olga (SRE): add synthetic checks for token refresh across regions, and a short-term rate limit to reduce error burst. Also capture KV miss metrics.
Elaine (PM): comms: Priya will tell customer schedule. Marco, can you coordinate the canary and postmortem template?
Marco (Release): yes. I'll own rollout and postmortem. Will notify #incidents and eng-oncall. deploy-bot will post deploy status.
Priya (Support): I'll tell customer: maintenance window tomorrow 10–12 UTC, brief canary at start, follow-up when fully rolled out. Ask if they want IP allowlist during window.
Sam (Eng): I'll cut the patch branch tonight and run tests in staging. Need sign-off from SRE for canary thresholds.
Olga (SRE): sign-off on thresholds: latency + error increase <15% and absolute error rate <0.5%. If exceeded, immediate rollback.
Elaine (PM): decision: hotfix via canary tomorrow. Owners: Sam (patch), Marco (rollout), Olga (SRE thresholds), Priya (customer comms).
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by Marco for 2026-03-19T10:00Z — canary 5% -> 100% if green.
Sam (Eng): noted. I'll post a short runbook in this thread before 09:30 UTC.
Priya (Support): done — customer notified and confirmed.
Elaine (PM): thanks all — please add any follow-ups in the thread.
Marco (Release): follow-up: include canary dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/internexus-canary (internal)
Sam (Eng): runbook snippet: ```
# quick smoke
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://dedicated.region/api/refresh
# expect 200 within 300ms
```
Olga (SRE): I'll add synthetic monitors and watch during rollout.
Elaine (PM): closing now — will post update after rollout. :thumbsup:
